acquisition method: MS data were acquired with a Top15 data-dependent MS/MS scan method (topN method).
cleavage agent: Trypsin and LysC (1:100 μg of enzyme to micrograms of protein ratio) were added to the mixture after a 5-min cooling step at room temperature.
collision energy: Fragmentation of precursor ions was performed by higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy of 27 eV.
enrichment method: depletion of the top 20 most abundant plasma proteins
We built up a matching library and used a depletion of the top 20 most abundant plasma proteins by a combination of two immunodepletion kits (Nagaraj et al, 2012; Geyer et al, 2016).
fragmentation method: Fragmentation of precursor ions was performed by higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy of 27 eV.
instrument: which was combined with a Q Exactive HF Orbitrap (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and a nano-electrospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific) (Scheltema et al, 2014).
ionization type: which was combined with a Q Exactive HF Orbitrap (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and a nano-electrospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific) (Scheltema et al, 2014).
labeling: Label-free protein quantitation (LFQ) was performed with a minimum ratio count of 1 (Cox et al, 2014).
